notes: Fixes ChatGPT blog translation failing with 'used its entire token budget on internal reasoning' on longer articles when a reasoning model (o3, o4-mini, gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, ...) is selected in AI Settings - the per-request token budget was too small to leave room for a long article's full translated output after the model's hidden reasoning tokens. Raised well within what every one of those models supports, so this no longer requires switching away from a reasoning model. No database update needed for this update.
